career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Punjab State Civil Services Combined Competitive Examination (PSCSCCE) into the premier state executive cadre—Punjab Civil Service (Executive Branch) [Class I]—commence their career as Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDM) / Assistant Commissioners and advance through the state civil administration hierarchy under the Punjab Civil Service (Executive Branch) (Class I) Rules, 1976 (as amended in 1989 and 2011). Senior officers are regularly inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the Punjab state promotion quota pursuant to the Indian Administrative Service (Appointment by Promotion) Regulations, 1955.

exam_scheme.note: Governed by the Punjab State Civil Services (Appointment by Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2009 (notified by Department of Personnel, Government of Punjab vide Notification No. G.S.R. 53/Const./Art.309/2009 dated 06.10.2009, as amended in 2014 and 2015). The examination is conducted in three successive stages: (1) Preliminary Competitive Examination (screening consisting of 2 objective papers of 200 marks each, 400 marks total, with NO negative marking, where both papers count towards preliminary merit shortlisting of candidates ~13 times the vacancies), (2) Main Written Examination (7 compulsory conventional descriptive papers totaling 1,350 marks, with minimum qualifying 25% in each paper and 45% aggregate in written), and (3) Interview / Viva-Voce (150 marks for candidates shortlisted ~3 times vacancies, requiring minimum 45% qualifying marks). Final selection rank is determined on the combined aggregate of 1,500 marks (1,350 Main Written + 150 Interview).

financial_package.note: Compensation for officers appointed to the Punjab Civil Service (Executive Branch) and Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) is governed by the Punjab Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2021 notified by the Department of Finance, Government of Punjab. Entry basic pay for PCS (EB) and DSP is ₹56,100 at Pay Matrix Level 10 (corresponding to unrevised Pay Band ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400). Allied services recruited through the same competitive examination enter at Level 8 for Tehsildar (Entry basic ₹47,600) and Level 7 for Block Development & Panchayat Officer (BDPO), Food & Supplies Controller, Assistant Registrar of Co-operative Societies (ARCS), Labour-cum-Conciliation Officer, and Employment Generation Officer (Entry basic ₹44,900). Note on Punjab probation rule: Under Punjab Government policy instructions (letters dated 15.01.2015 and 17.07.2020), newly recruited officers receive fixed minimum basic pay without allowances during their probation period, after which regular allowances (DA, HRA, mobile, transport) are admissible in full.

financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross salary is computed from Level 10 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + Punjab HRA (ranging from 8% to 16% depending on posting in Category A cities like Mohali/Ludhiana/Amritsar vs district headquarters) + fixed medical allowance (₹1,000) and special executive allowance. Net in-hand estimate reflects statutory deductions including 10% NPS contributory pension (Basic + DA = ₹8,864), Punjab Development Tax (₹200/month), and GIS. Note: Under Government of Punjab notification instructions, during the initial probation period appointees draw fixed basic pay (₹56,100) without allowances.
